confirmation_split: all 124 calibration-sequence frames; select by macro mIoU over fog/night/rain/snow
coordinate_policy: Tune one parameter at a time and freeze its best value before moving on.
held_out_split: 282 frames from disjoint sequences; never read by this script
selection_split: tuning_proxy: 8 frames per weather from calibration-only sequences
weather_aggregation: Each configuration is evaluated once on the pooled split with per-image confusion statistics; fog/night/rain/snow mIoU values are then reconstructed and macro-averaged.
